description: Christmas Island Road Network – 2013 Update is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Cities and Regional Development. In May 2013, the Christmas Island road layer (as used in the NATMAP 1:30,000k general reference map of Christmas Island) was updated using the 2011 orthophotography and data provided by Christmas Island National Park in 2012. Significant manual digitising was undertaken to align all roads with the orthophotography. Coverage: Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Cities and Regional Development. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Cities and Regional Development. Its tags are Christmas, IOT, infrastructure, roads, topographic. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-06-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
